title: slice run names the failing verify step
body:
Outcome: when `krn verify` fails inside `krn slice run`, the cause names the failing step and its log (the `<step> FAIL exit=N log=...` line) instead of the first output line.
Evidence: PR #205 (t-4sesbm3): `slice verify exit=1: lint PASS completed` while the targeted step failed; the lead had to rerun krn verify by hand.
Proof: an observer whose stub verify prints a PASS line then a FAIL line; the cause names the FAIL step.
Lead trap: when `slice verify` fails, run `bin/krn verify --base <base> --observer <file>` in the worktree to see the FAIL step and its log.
